order: 판단 비교·절제 발주문 v1 고침 1 (2026-11-17, 사용자 전달 20시대)
no_training: true (except the 4.6 logistic regression reference row)
device: CPU only, nice -n 19, container <= 32 GB, wait when host memory use > 80 %

inputs.JC: PH/main_judgecheck_v2/PHD-MAIN-JUDGECHECK-v2 (read only): analysis/gt_<prior>.npz (GT points: paired, gid, case, xyz, normal, gt_kind, tau, patch_kind, group, place, textureless, building, src, site, target_ok_v[8], region_v[8], target_distance_v[8]), geometry_raw (patch_id), truth/gt_patch (gt_p for the 5 % check), sight (free5, free10), stage0/tau.json, judge/base.json t_rows
inputs.JP: PH/main_judgeprobe_v1/PHD-MAIN-JUDGEPROBE-v1 (read only): patch_<prior>.npz (JC patch values in JC gid order), photo_<prior>.npz (photo points), na_<prior>.npz (variant ga = t_M)
inputs.JA: PH/main_judgeapply_v1/PHD-MAIN-JUDGEAPPLY-v1 (read only): decisions/<site>__<prior>.npz region[4] = fusion (mvsfuse in_change_25 -> 2 else 1), core_points; JC truth/exp/<site>__<prior>.npz current_patch_id (GT rows -> JUDGEAPPLY patches by the RESCORE prism rule, JUDGECHECK-v2 2.5)
inputs.code: JC scripts/phd/main_judgecheck_v2/jc2_judge.py (decide, threshold, quantile, target_height, photo_code) and JP scripts (common, p3_na rescoring rule) copied by import, not modified

scoring.rule: JUDGECHECK-v2 2.5: GT point takes the judgment and target of its patch (gid); target ok = |plane distance along the GT normal to the target plane (patch centre + h normal)| <= tau; no target = wrong. Distance recomputed (JC plane_distance) only for patches whose target height differs from the stored base method target; other points keep the stored base target_ok.
scoring.cases: JC current definition 0 both valid, 1 prior error, 2 image-depth error, 4 image-depth missing; always the four in this order
scoring.total: all paired GT points of the four cases

summary.a: mean of the four case target-ok % (equal weight)
summary.b: minimum of the four and its case
summary.c: max over cases of (best target-ok % among variants that do not use GT, same prior x surface x scope) - this variant; excluded from the best: oracle (upper bound), 4.6 reference, 3.1 GT-selected rows, and the three-region-only 기존 4 row when the scope is all buildings

scoring.name_ok: region == expected judgment of the case (0->일치, 1->영상 깊이 사용, 2->사전정보 사용, 4->결측)
scoring.made_error: share of the case's GT points where this variant's target is outside tau but the prior-only or image-only target is inside tau (JC made_saved rule)
scoring.vs_base: target-ok %p per case; changed area = sum of patch area with region different from base (patches holding GT or not), transition table from->to
scoring.per_building: building x case target-ok %; difference to base per building x case cell with >= 200 GT points: median, IQR, count base better / worse
scoring.splits_in_files: group (전체, 세 실험 지역, 나머지 = JC gt group), place (면 안쪽, 면 경계, 건물 가장자리 = JC gt place), textureless (JC gt textureless 1/0)
scoring.surfaces: LoD2: 지붕, 벽, 모두 (patch_kind of the GT point's patch); ALS: 지붕

common_patch_sets.valid: finite prior height and finite patch normal
common_patch_sets.present: valid and n >= 4 and finite MVS mean height
common_patch_sets.outside: valid and geometry code 1 (base L unless the variant changes detection)
common_patch_sets.no_uM: present and geometry code 9 and u_M not finite (11/4 rule)
common_patch_sets.free: JC sight free10 for roof patches, free5 for wall patches (base)
common_patch_sets.default: LoD2 영상 깊이 사용 (2), ALS 사전정보 사용 (1)
common_patch_sets.photo_codes_1_4: photo code 7 사진 부족, 6 무늬 없음, 4 MVS 면 없음, 5 조각 부족 (and 9 셈 안 함, no score) -> default where the order says '차례 1~4는 그대로 기본 판정'
common_patch_sets.target_height: JC target_height: 일치 = precision-weighted mean with base u_M, sigma_P, sigma_W; 사전정보 사용·결측 = prior height; 영상 깊이 사용 = MVS mean height; 제거·미판정 = none

baselines_section3.missing_rule: n < 4 (missing set) -> 결측 (prior kept) for 기존 1, 2, 3, 5 (no sight test); patches outside valid/present/missing stay 미판정
baselines_section3.d: JC geometry/base d_for_check (= d_m = MVS mean height - prior height along the normal)

old1.name: 기존 1 높이 빼기
old1.rule: present: |d| <= T -> 사전정보 사용, else 영상 깊이 사용

old2.name: 기존 2 유의 차이 검출
old2.rule: present: |d| <= L_k -> 사전정보 사용, else 영상 깊이 사용; L_k = k (sqrt(u_M^2 + sigma_P^2 + sigma_W^2) + |r|) with base u_M, sigma_P, sigma_W, r; L_k not finite -> 사전정보 사용 (area recorded)

old3.name: 기존 3 사전 정보를 영상으로 검증
old3.rule: present: s_P available and s_P < t_q -> 영상 깊이 사용, else 사전정보 사용
old3.s_P_available: photo point scored, finite s_P, selected images of the prior plane >= 3, texture strength of the prior piece >= 5 (the s_P-side parts of photo codes 7, 6, 5)
old3.t_q: JC t rule with quantile q: photo points whose member patches are all inside base L, per search region x prior x kind ('none' = seven regions pooled), same <= 5000 random sample and seed list as JC/JP t (seed 20261112, [seed, region index or 7, prior 0/1, kind]); area-weighted quantile q of s_P

old4.name: 기존 4 MVS 기반 결합
old4.three_regions: JUDGEAPPLY decisions region[4] (mvsfuse_<prior> detect in_change_25 -> 영상 깊이 사용, else 사전정보 사용; all patches including n < 4) scored on JC GT rows of the three experiment sites (src 1) via truth/exp current_patch_id and the JUDGEAPPLY core patch plane (centre, normal; target = prior height or MVS mean height); compared rows use the same GT rows

old5.name: 기존 5 두 단서 결합
old5.rule: present: |d| > T and s_P available and s_P < t -> 영상 깊이 사용, else 사전정보 사용
rows: T = L (base L, 1.96; L not finite -> 사전정보 사용)

baselines_section3.gt_selected: per type (기존 1, 2, 3) and prior x surface: the sweep value with the highest summary (a); marked '참값으로 고름'; excluded from the best in summary (c)

ablations_section4.one_change: every variant changes only the listed item from the base; tau, r, t, sigma_W, cylinders, photo selection, decision table, default, targets = JC base stored values

detect.det1: fixed threshold 0.5 m instead of L for all present patches (incl. no u_M): |d| <= 0.5 -> 일치, else identification as base (photo code)
detect.det3: one limit per search region x prior x kind: over present patches (n >= 4, finite d) of that region ('none' patches use the seven regions pooled), area-weighted median m and NMAD = 1.4826 x area-weighted median |d - m|; |d - m| <= 1.96 NMAD -> 일치
detect.det4: u_M = SD of MVS heights in the cylinder / sqrt(n) (geometry_raw mvs_sd_m, n); L = 1.96 (sqrt(u^2 + sigma_P^2 + sigma_W^2) + |r|); applied to no-u_M patches too; L not finite -> as base no-u_M (photo)
detect.agree_target: precision-weighted mean with base weights; base u_M not finite -> mean of prior and MVS heights (area recorded)
detect.five_percent: JC s8 five_percent: patches with n >= 4, finite gt_p, prior and MVS height both within tau of gt_p (cell 0) and finite variant limit; area share with |d| beyond the variant limit; per kind

identify.applies_to: outside and no-u_M patches of the base; inside stays 일치
identify.id3: s_P available and s_P < t -> 영상 깊이 사용; s_P available and s_P >= t -> 사전정보 사용; else default
identify.id4: s_M available and s_M >= t -> 영상 깊이 사용; s_M available and s_M < t -> 사전정보 사용; else default; s_M available = scored, finite s_M, MVS plane available, selected images of the MVS plane >= 3, texture of the MVS piece >= 5
identify.id5: c_lo, c_hi = area-weighted 5 % and 95 % of (s_M - s_P) over the same photo-point sample as t (per region x prior x kind); photo codes 7, 6, 4, 5, 9 -> default; s_M - s_P > c_hi -> 영상 깊이 사용; < c_lo -> 사전정보 사용; else default
identify.id6: photo codes 7, 6, 4, 5, 9 -> default; s_M > s_P -> 영상 깊이 사용, else 사전정보 사용
identify.id7: reference = the same photo-point sample as t; q_P = area-weighted CDF of s_P in the sample's s_P distribution, q_M likewise in its s_M distribution; codes 7, 6, 4, 5, 9 -> default; q_M > q_P -> 영상 깊이 사용, else 사전정보 사용
identify.id8: JP na_<prior>.npz region_new, target_h_new (s_P vs t, s_M vs t_M)
identify.check: geometry-consistency-only (JC) = id1 for LoD2, id2 for ALS

abstain.ab1: photo codes 2 (both low) and 3 (both high): s_M > s_P -> 영상 깊이 사용, else 사전정보 사용; others as base
abstain.ab2: JC alt_na (판 나) stored region and target

process.extra: case-0 GT points: median and NMAD of |distance to target| (base vs variant)

visibility.vis1: missing (n < 4) -> 결측 for all (no sight test)

reference_4_6.model: three-class multinomial logistic regression (sklearn, lbfgs, C = 1.0, max_iter 2000), area-weighted, standardised inputs
reference_4_6.target: patch case 0, 1, 2 for n >= 4 and not mixed patches
reference_4_6.inputs: JP obs.py candidate observations 1-14 (the 14 listed in the JUDGEPROBE-v1 order 3.1; 15 and 16 were added by that task and are not used; 10-12 as the min forms), prior type as an indicator over a model fitted on both priors pooled, roof/wall indicator; missing -> median + missing flag
reference_4_6.mapping: 0 -> 일치, 1 -> 영상 깊이 사용, 2 -> 사전정보 사용; n < 4 and mixed -> base

fusion_all_section5.rule: the same mvsfuse detect implementation and colour threshold 25 over all buildings; budget 3 h estimated from the first search region

figures.fig1: per prior: x = four cases + 전체, bars = prior only, image only, 기존 1 (0.5 m, 1.0 m), 기존 2, 기존 3, 기존 5 (0.5 m, L), 본 방법, 상한; 기존 4 three-region-only bar in a separate panel of the same figure (bundle 가)
figures.fig2: per prior (LoD2 = 모두): columns 검출, 식별, 유보, 처리, 가시성; per variant four case points; base as horizontal lines per case
figures.fig5: per prior two panels: left x prior-error target-ok, y image-depth-error; right x prior-error, y both-valid; 기존 1, 2, 3 sweeps as lines; prior only, image only, 기존 4 (three regions, marked), 기존 5, 본 방법, 상한 as points

outputs.variants_npz: PH/main_judgeabl_v1/PHD-MAIN-JUDGEABL-v1/variants/<search region>__<prior>.npz: patch_id, variant names, region[V,N], reason[V,N], target_h[V,N]
